leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a Higher-Order Component function that accepts a WrappedComponent parameter
Apply TypeScript generics to create a type-safe HOC that preserves component props
Construct a new component that returns the WrappedComponent with its original props
Implement conditional rendering logic to check authentication status
Control component flow by redirecting unauthenticated users to a login page
Use React hooks within the HOC to access authentication state from context or Redux
Handle authentication state changes by subscribing to context or store updates
Return appropriate JSX based on whether the user is authenticated or not
Apply the withAuth HOC to wrap existing functional components
Utilize component composition to maintain separation of concerns between authentication and business logic
Access and pass through all original props to the wrapped component when authenticated
Modify component behavior by adding authentication checks without altering the original component's implementation
